name: Viveka Backend - Development
description:
Development environment for Viveka Backend API testing

IMPORTANT NOTES:

1. Update 'phoneNumber' and 'otp' before testing
   - Run 'Send OTP' to get the OTP from server logs (register=1234, login=4321 in dev)
   - Replace the 'otp' value with the one printed in console if different

2. IDs are auto-populated:
   - clientId, token, deviceSessionId (from Register auto-login or Login)
   - itemGroupId (from Create Item Group)
   - itemId (from Create Item)
   - clientCustomerId (from Create Client clientCustomer)
   - cartId (from Create Cart)
   - cartItemId (from Add Item to Cart)
   - invoiceId (from Generate Invoice)

3. Testing sequence:
   1. Send OTP (purpose=register)
   2. Register Client (auto-login + token issued)
   3. Send OTP (purpose=login) — optional if you want to rotate token/device
   4. Login Client (optional; enforces one active device and can refresh token)
   5. Proceed with business flows (items, client clientCustomers, carts, invoices) — Authorization: Bearer {{token}} is auto-applied by collection auth
   6. Logout Client using Authorization Bearer token (no client/device IDs in body)

4. Server must be running:
   npm install (to install dependencies)
   npm start (to start server on port 5000)
   MongoDB must be running on localhost:27017
